page.overview:
Who is Benito Grasso?

Benito Grasso was a wealthy Tilean man. Seduced by the promises of gold he made a successful short-term alliance with the Ratmen, which drove him to ever-greater heights of ambition and betrayal. All the ratmen ask from him was more and more Warpstone.
